info.title: MDM Dismissed Pair
info.description: Pairs of objects a person reviewed and ruled not the same. Rows are written only by the dismissal routes and read by DuplicateDetectionService, which stops offering a pair whose value fingerprint still matches its dismissal. RBAC-scoped and auditable through OpenRegister's object infrastructure (ADR-022) rather than a bespoke table.

x-openregister.description: Foundational MDM dismissed-pair register shipped by OpenRegister so a reviewed false pair is not offered again.

dismissed-pair.title: Dismissed Pair
dismissed-pair.description: One row per pair of objects reviewed and ruled not duplicates.

dismissedPair.title: Dismissed Pair
dismissedPair.summary: A pair of objects a person decided are not the same.
dismissedPair.description: Written by the dismissal route and read by the duplicate scorer. The two uuids are stored in a canonical order so a pair has one row whichever way round it was reviewed, and the fingerprint records what the values looked like at the moment of the judgement, so the pair is offered again once the data behind it changes.

objectA.description: Uuid of the first object, in canonical (string-sorted) order.
objectA.title: Object A

objectB.description: Uuid of the second object, in canonical (string-sorted) order.
objectB.title: Object B

registerSlug.description: Register the pair was reviewed in.
registerSlug.title: Register

schemaSlug.description: Schema the pair was reviewed under.
schemaSlug.title: Schema

fingerprint.description: Hash of the normalised values of the compared properties at the moment of the judgement. The scorer offers the pair again as soon as this no longer matches.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

reason.description: Why the reviewer decided the two are not the same.
reason.title: Reason

dismissedBy.description: Uid of the person who made the judgement.
dismissedBy.title: Dismissed By

reversedBy.description: Uid of the person who undid the dismissal, when one has.
reversedBy.title: Reversed By

reversedAt.description: When the dismissal was undone, when it has been.
reversedAt.title: Reversed At

active.description: False once the dismissal has been reversed. The row is kept rather than deleted so the audit trail of who decided what, and who undid it, survives.
active.title: Active
